import random


class Generator(random.Random):
    pass


def draw(seed: int) -> float:
    generator = random.Random(seed)
    generator.seed(seed + 1)
    generator.seed(*(seed + 2,))
    generator.seed(**{"a": seed + 3})
    return (
        generator.random()
        + random.Random(seed).random()
        + random.Random(*(seed,)).random()
        + random.Random(**{"x": seed}).random()
        + Generator(seed).random()
    )
